create_OfflineReplay: create an OfflineReplay buffer with configurable priority levels for storing replay memory entries
use_OfflineReplay_add: add a memory entry to a specific priority level in the OfflineReplay buffer
use_OfflineReplay_sample: sample a random sequence of T consecutive entries from the OfflineReplay buffer
create_BatchAssemblerOffline: create a BatchAssemblerOffline to collect and sample offline batches from multiple agent replay memories
use_BatchAssemblerOffline_get_batch: get a random batch of samples from available agent memories for offline training
